questions.q: Salicylaldehyde is treated with H₂O₂ in aqueous NaOH. The organic products are:
questions.explain: The aryl group migrates from carbon to oxygen, giving an aryl formate that base hydrolyses, so –CHO is replaced by –OH (catechol) and the carbonyl carbon leaves as HCOO⁻.

questions.q: Which compound does NOT give a benzenediol under Dakin conditions (H₂O₂, aqueous base)?
questions.explain: A meta OH cannot push electron density onto the ring carbon bonded to the C=O, so hydrogen migrates instead and 3-hydroxybenzoic acid forms rather than resorcinol.

questions.q: 4-Hydroxyacetophenone undergoes the Dakin reaction. Besides hydroquinone, the other product is:
questions.explain: The carbonyl carbon leaves together with its R group as RCOO⁻; with a methyl ketone R = CH₃, so acetate forms. Formate comes only from aldehydes.

questions.q: 4-Aminoacetophenone is warmed with H₂O₂ and OH⁻. The main aromatic product is:
questions.explain: A para NH₂ activates the ring just as OH does, so the aryl group migrates to oxygen and the acetyl group is replaced by OH. The NH₂ group itself is not replaced.
